store.title: App Store
store.subtitle: Browse Pocket software compatible with the connected device. Signatures and digests are verified before anything is installed.
store.loadFailed: The catalog could not be loaded.

verdict.requiresPreparation: The device does not meet the installation requirements yet.
verdict.unsupportedModel: The connected device model is not supported.
verdict.unsupportedOs: The connected OS version is not supported.
verdict.unknownDevice: Device information is incomplete. Check the connection and refresh.
verdict.unsupportedInstaller: Studio does not support this installation target yet.
verdict.withdrawn: This application or release has been withdrawn.
verdict.catalogExpired: Refresh the expired catalog before installing.

detail.installHint: The package is downloaded and verified before it is transferred to the device.
detail.prepareHint: This package depends on a jailbroken environment.

resolve.title: Resolve package
resolve.detail: Confirm the version, dependencies and target device.

download.title: Download
download.detail: Fetch the package from the repository.

verify.title: Verify signature and digest
verify.detail: A failed verification stops before anything reaches the device.

transfer.title: Transfer to device
transfer.detail: Copy the package to the device over USB.

install.title: Install
install.detail: Run the installer on the device. This step cannot be interrupted.

verifyInstall.title: Verify install
verifyInstall.detail: Confirm the package is registered and can launch.

uninstall.title: Uninstall application
uninstall.detail: The system removes the app and its data container.

downloadFailed.title: Download failed
downloadFailed.body: The package could not be fetched from the repository. Check the network and retry.

checksumMismatch.title: Verification failed
checksumMismatch.body: The package digest does not match the catalog. The install was stopped. Refresh the catalog and try again; never skip verification manually.

transferFailed.title: Transfer failed
transferFailed.body: Copying to the device was interrupted. Check the connection and retry.

installRejected.title: The device rejected the install
installRejected.body: The system installer rejected the operation without a more specific diagnosis. Review the operation record and device environment.

verificationFailed.title: Install verification failed
verificationFailed.body: The install command ran, but the package was not found on the device.

deviceDisconnected.title: Device disconnected
deviceDisconnected.body: The device disconnected during the install. Reconnect and retry.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.body: The install was cancelled at a safe point.

verificationUnavailable.title: Verification incomplete
verificationUnavailable.body: Verification is incomplete. Use “Check device state” to retry read-only observation; no installation will be replayed.

deviceChanged.title: The selected device changed. Review a new plan for the intended device.
deviceChanged.body: The bound device is unavailable or has changed. Reconnect it and review a new plan.

signatureRejected.title: The device rejected the IPA signature
signatureRejected.body: Catalog and file integrity checks passed, but iOS did not accept the app signature. Prepare AppSync in the device environment; if installed, check plugin loading and signing compatibility.

source.expired: This catalog has expired. Refresh it before installing or updating applications.

sourceErrors.storeUnconfigured: Configure a trusted store source to browse published applications.
sourceErrors.invalidStoreSource: The store source configuration is invalid.
sourceErrors.storeOffline: The store could not be reached.
sourceErrors.invalidStoreResponse: The store returned an invalid response.
sourceErrors.storeStorageFailed: The store cache could not be read or written.
sourceErrors.unsupportedCatalogSchema: This catalog requires a newer version of Studio.
sourceErrors.untrustedCatalog: The catalog source or signing key is not trusted.
sourceErrors.catalogRollback: An older or conflicting catalog was rejected.
sourceErrors.checksumMismatch: Downloaded content did not match its expected digest.

installed.readFailed: Device applications could not be read. Previously observed records are shown when available; this does not mean the device is empty.
installed.notice: Includes applications installed outside the store when their native identity matches. Download size is not the installed storage footprint.

actions.planning: Checking the device and selecting a compatible artifact…
actions.installs: This installs a User application through the device’s normal installation service.
actions.preservesData: The application will be replaced through the system update service. Its data container is retained.
actions.removesData: Uninstalling removes the application and its data container from this device.
actions.unknownRequirements: Some installation prerequisites could not be confirmed. You can try a normal User installation. If the device rejects its signature, check AppSync and signing on the device.
actions.catalogValid: Catalog valid until {time}. A verified, complete cache permits offline installation.
actions.deleteConsent: I understand that uninstalling deletes this application’s data.
actions.deviceChanged: The selected device changed. Review a new plan for the intended device.
actions.cleanupPending: The operation’s staging file could not be removed. It is retained when device submission is uncertain.
actions.jobsUnavailable: Application operation records could not be read.
actions.verificationUnavailable: Device verification could not be started. Connect the original device and try again.

errors.storeUnconfigured: A trusted application catalog is unavailable. Configure or refresh the store source.
errors.catalogExpired: Refresh the expired catalog before installing or updating.
errors.packageWithdrawn: The application or selected release has been withdrawn. Review the current catalog.
errors.incompatiblePackage: This artifact is incompatible with the device or its installation requirements.
errors.deviceChanged: The bound device is unavailable or has changed. Reconnect it and review a new plan.
errors.installedStateChanged: The installed version changed after planning. Refresh device apps and review a new plan.
errors.packageDowngrade: The installed native version or build is newer. This operation would downgrade it and was stopped.
errors.invalidPackageAction: This action does not match the installed state. Unknown store builds require explicit reinstall.
errors.appsyncMissing: AppSync is missing from the device’s installed package records. Install it manually and refresh.
errors.operationBusy: Another operation already owns this application or device. Wait for it to finish.
errors.planExpired: The plan expired or was already used. Review a new plan.
errors.invalidConsent: Confirm the operation and, for uninstall, acknowledge data removal.
errors.notCancellable: The system request has been submitted and cannot be cancelled safely.
errors.unknownOperation: The operation could not be found or has finished.
errors.storeStorageFailed: Operation state could not be persisted. Check the device before starting another write.
errors.installRejected: The device’s system installer rejected this operation. Check installation requirements and available space.
errors.signatureRejected: Catalog and file integrity checks passed, but iOS did not accept the app signature. Prepare AppSync in the device environment; if installed, check plugin loading and signing compatibility.
errors.deviceStorageFull: The device reported insufficient storage. Free space on the device and review a new plan.
errors.verificationUnavailable: Verification is incomplete. Use “Check device state” to retry read-only observation; no installation will be replayed.
errors.verificationFailed: The registered application does not match the expected version, build or receipt. Check the device before starting another write.
errors.checksumMismatch: The IPA does not match its signed digest or native metadata. Installation was stopped.
errors.downloadFailed: The package could not be downloaded. Refresh the catalog or provide a complete verified cache.
errors.cancelled: The operation was cancelled before system submission.
errors.unknown: The application operation could not be completed. Refresh its state and try again.
errors.systemApplication: The matching app is registered as a System application. Store operations require a User application; handle the existing system installation manually.
errors.applicationTypeUnknown: The native application type could not be confirmed. Refresh device apps before retrying.
